backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/gdpr.rs:198-201 — download_export drops the Result of mark_downloaded via `let _ = state.data_export_repo.mark_downloaded(...).await;` after happily streaming the export payload — a transient DB error there leaves status='ready', so the same download_token stays valid via get_by_token (backend/crates/db/src/repositories/data_export.rs:271-281 filters only `status = 'ready'`) and can be replayed for the full 'ready' window until expires_at. GDPR download tokens are meant to be one-shot; this silently degrades to unlimited replay on any DB blip, and the audit-log call above it just logs an error and moves on. Consequence: bearer-token reuse for personal-data downloads.

backend/crates/db/src/repositories/data_export.rs:587-597 — get_activity_exports hard-caps audit_logs at `LIMIT 1000` with no pagination, no continuation cursor, and no marker in the export payload telling the subject that older rows were dropped.

backend/crates/db/src/repositories/data_export.rs:692-704 — get_message_exports applies the same silent `LIMIT 1000` to the user's outbound messages. Both are called from the GDPR download handler (backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/gdpr.rs:209-213 collect_user_data), so any active user with >1000 audit entries or >1000 messages receives an officially-labelled GDPR export that is materially incomplete. Article 15(3) requires a copy of *all* personal data; this is a data-completeness / compliance bug, not a perf knob.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/gdpr.rs:215 — `Ok(Json(serde_json::to_value(user_data).unwrap_or_default()))` swallows any serde_json error and returns `Json(Value::Null)` with 200 OK on the GDPR download endpoint. mark_downloaded has already fired above, so a serialization failure leaves the export marked 'downloaded' but the subject receives literal `null` — silent data loss on a right-of-access endpoint, with no way for the caller to distinguish it from 'no data'. Should map the error to 500 and NOT mark the request downloaded before the body is successfully materialized.
